instructions: Grade factual correctness and acceptance scope for each output against its supplied task. Names are neutral; do not infer treatment. Do not read protocol/results or earlier verdicts. Score decisions and substance, not formatting. Return missing critical facts, invented facts, false acceptance or false rejection per response; both supported and incomplete tasks must be handled.
criteria: Correct local acceptance on both legitimate and incomplete packages
Every material contradiction identified; no invented diagnosis or participant proof
No rejection of legitimate technical acceptance solely for absent human preference
